findings.description: Critical: service policy denials preserve unconstrained PolicyDecision.reason strings such as write_denied or agent_suspended, but the HTTP mapper recognizes only three exact forbidden tokens; real policy denials therefore fall through to a 422 validation Problem instead of the required 403 policy Problem.
findings.resolution: Carry an explicit failure category from WorkQueueService or normalize every policy denial to a stable policy_denied code while preserving detail separately, map that category to 403, and test a real non-whitelisted PolicyDecision.reason value.

findings.description: none: projection submit and reconcile request models now forbid undeclared top-level and nested projection-key fields, matching additionalProperties=false.
findings.resolution: Retain the strict request models and regression tests.

findings.description: none: depends_on is now typed as UUID at the Pydantic boundary and malformed values are covered by an HTTP 422 application/problem+json test.
findings.resolution: Retain the boundary type and malformed-dependency regression test.
